GOAL: Paint the grid using four colors by stamping rotated shapes. CONTROLS: Click swatches to pick color, arrows to move the view, Space to stamp. RULE: Each stamp covers a half-plane; the last color laid down on any cell is the one that stays visible. TRAP: You cannot erase color by painting over it.

GOAL: Clear the path to the exit by eliminating all hostile guards without being spotted. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step per press. RULE: You can only kill a guard by walking directly into them from the side they do not face. TRAP: Walking into a guard from the direction they look causes immediate failure; always approach from their blind side.

GOAL: Paint the grid with four specific colors by overlapping shapes, ending with eight scattered blue cells. CONTROLS: Arrow keys navigate between tool poses; Space selects a tool; clicks apply a paint bucket. RULE: Layer order matters: paint large regions first, then smaller overlays, ensuring later tools cover earlier ones correctly. TRAP: Believing the red rectangle covers all blue cells, missing the eight blue cells outside the red area.

GOAL: Align shapes to satisfy match patterns using efficient movement. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece; SPACE cycles through pieces. RULE: Pressing SPACE on a matched piece yields no visual change, but still updates selection. TRAP: Assuming a blank response means the command failed, rather than realizing selection changed invisibly.

GOAL: Guide a beam through a rotating legend to unlock the final gate. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step in any cardinal direction. RULE: Touching the prism changes the legend color, allowing the beam to pass only when colors match. TRAP: Assuming one touch fixes the color permanently; the legend rotates, requiring re-alignment at specific intervals.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit while avoiding the moving guard and the stationary killer. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step in that direction. RULE: The dark guard moves toward you only when you are in its column; step into its column only when safe. TRAP: Assuming the guard is a static patroller; it actually chases you, so entering its column prematurely leads to a collision.

GOAL: Guide the hero past charging guards to reach the exit safely. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the hero one step in the pressed direction. RULE: Guards charge two cells straight only if the hero is in their line of sight. TRAP: Thinking you can cut across a guard's column; the guard strikes before you escape.

GOAL: Move the plug between water reservoirs by matching water levels. CONTROLS: Click pumps to raise or lower water columns; click open gates to transfer the plug. RULE: Gates only open when adjacent reservoirs reach equal water heights, allowing the plug to cross. TRAP: Assuming clicking a closed gate moves the plug, or ignoring that pumps adjust both the target and the donor column simultaneously.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit before the countdown timer hits zero. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character one step in that direction. RULE: The orange enemy moves independently along a fixed path regardless of your position. TRAP: Assuming the enemy waits or reacts to you causes delays; treat it as a moving obstacle.

GOAL: Position vertical and horizontal mirror lines correctly, then move the tetromino into the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object. SPACE cycles selection between the piece and mirror lines. RULE: Mirrors reflect shapes across their axis; both must align with the grid to fit the piece through the reflection. TRAP: Believing arrows move the piece immediately fails; you must select the specific mirror or piece first.

GOAL: Slide to the yellow node to refill your moves, then slide to the box. CONTROLS: Arrows make you slide until you hit a wall or obstacle. RULE: You must pass through the yellow node before the final push to survive. TRAP: Believing you can reach the box without refilling leads to running out of moves mid-slide.

ESTABLISHED: The yellow pattern is rotationally symmetric, not a direct piece coverage target. FAILED: Trying to fit piece A into the yellow pattern; piece A’s five-block run exceeds the pattern’s four-block maximum. GOAL IS NOT: Covering the yellow shape with piece bodies or reflections, as the geometry makes this impossible. CONTROLS: Horizontal and vertical lines move via presses; repositioning their intersection to the pattern’s center is the likely solution.

GOAL: Guide the robot to the exit while dodging patrollers. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the robot. RULE: Patrollers follow fixed, repeating paths that create safe windows to cross. TRAP: Assuming the path is static; remember that patrollers can share a cell, so you must wait for them to move out before entering their route.

GOAL: Navigate the core to the exit using a limited step budget. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the core; clicking buttons rotates gates. RULE: Only arrow presses consume steps; clicks are free. TRAP: Assuming clicks reduce the step counter leads to wasted planning and hesitation.

GOAL: Move selected mirrors to target spots while managing selection cycles and grid constraints. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active mirror; SPACE cycles through available mirrors. RULE: Only one action per code snippet ensures state updates before next command. TRAP: Assuming multiple controls work together caused errors because state didn't refresh.

GOAL: Deliver colored tokens to matching target circles. CONTROLS: Click a target location to move the nearest token there. RULE: Tokens merge automatically if they land within six units of each other. TRAP: Clicking the circle's edge fails; you must click the exact center to cover it.

GOAL: Navigate to the hidden purple hat icon to unlock the ghost-toggle button. CONTROLS: Arrows move the core; clicks activate panel buttons. RULE: Partially covering the hidden icon triggers the pickup, revealing the control switch. TRAP: Thinking you must fully cover the icon; touching just a few pixels is enough.

GOAL: Align both group centers onto their matching rings. CONTROLS: Click pieces to park them. Click rings to move all parked pieces to that ring. RULE: Moving pieces to a ring shifts the group center to that ring's location. TRAP: Focusing only on the final position ignores that intermediate moves alter the average, wasting steps.

GOAL: Grow the sky and shrink the red to clear the path. CONTROLS: R-minus shrinks the red bar; S-plus expands the sky bar. RULE: Obstacles block growth, so the red must vacate its rows before the sky can extend right. TRAP: Trusting the bounding box failed because a visual glitch hid the true length, leading to wasted moves.

GOAL: Guide the explorer through a grid to the target while avoiding guards and moving obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; moving into a wall or off-grid acts as a no-op. RULE: Guards destroy you if they lunge into your cell; you destroy guards by entering their rear, but never their front. TRAP: No-op moves do not advance guard patrols, so wasting turns leaves obstacles stationary rather than moving them away.

GOAL: Guide the yellow block to the highlighted bracket in every star. CONTROLS: Arrow keys spin the block around the star’s arms; other keys slide it inward or outward to change its radius. RULE: The large switch at the end moves every block to its paired bracket cell, solving all stars at once. TRAP: Do not assume you must align the block with the bracket before pressing the switch; it just needs to be at the outermost edge.

GOAL: Route both symbols home while recoloring them to match their target zones. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active symbol; SPACE switches between the cross and plus shapes. RULE: A symbol keeps its new color even after leaving the matching zone. TRAP: Assuming colors revert upon leaving the zone caused unnecessary return trips to re-probe.

GOAL: Reach the exit while evading a sleeping entity that wakes upon your approach. CONTROLS: Move one cell per turn to navigate corridors and destroy the final guard. RULE: The entity moves at your speed; maintain your lead and never reverse direction. TRAP: Do not assume the guard is static or that speed differences allow catching up.

GOAL: Equalize water levels to reveal a hidden gate and transfer the key. CONTROLS: Clicks shifted water volume between adjacent panels and activated orange gates. RULE: A gate opens only when neighboring water levels match and the key sits within its span. TRAP: Assuming equal water was enough to open a gate; the key’s specific position was also required.

GOAL: Place two gold blocks into the side brackets without pushing each other off target. CONTROLS: Top keys shift blocks up or down; bottom keys slide blocks left or right. RULE: One key moves the top track alone; the bottom key moves both bottom tracks together, linking their fates. TRAP: Believing the tracks are separate fails; sliding the bottom row spins the corner block, ruining the other bracket if not planned first.

GOAL: Carry the red key to the lamp and rotate the top bar to bridge the gap. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token two cells at a time along the bar structure. RULE: Rotating the bar aligns its upper section with the yellow target zone for victory. TRAP: The token does not slide continuously but jumps in distinct two-cell steps, breaking standard path assumptions.

GOAL: Slide three glowing hub clusters to align their colored sectors, guiding the white bead safely to its matching home ring. CONTROLS: Click a hub to shift it up, right, down, or left, moving all attached beads together along the grid. RULE: Hubs connect only when their overlapping edges display identical colors, forming continuous paths for the bead to travel across. TRAP: Assuming hubs move independently. Forgetting that moving one hub drags all connected beads causes misalignment and wasted turns.

GOAL: Move the plug between side channels by opening a temporary passage. CONTROLS: Click the center channel to open or close the door; click side channels to raise or lower water levels. RULE: The door only opens when the two side channels have identical water heights. TRAP: Trying to lift the exit channel while the door is blocked; you must equalize the sides first, then cross before changing levels again.

ESTABLISHED: Four copies exist at fixed mirrors; overlapping cells cancel out instead of stacking. FAILED: Aligning a single copy to match isolated yellow segments without balancing the other three copies. GOAL IS NOT: Placing any individual piece exactly on a single yellow cluster. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the base piece, shifting all four copies simultaneously according to the active mirror axes.

GOAL: Place all blocks and rings into nested panels to form the correct color sequence. CONTROLS: Click to move items between slots; press space to confirm the solution. RULE: A ring in a slot inserts the matching colored panel, expanding the available space for subsequent blocks. TRAP: Assuming rings are just blockers; they actually define where sub-panels open, requiring you to place rings before filling the new slots.

GOAL: Raise the water on the right side until the gate unlocks, then click it to send the arrow through. CONTROLS: Click the right pump to raise the middle section's water level, and click the gate to release the arrow. RULE: The gate only opens when the water level on the far side clears the window opening entirely. TRAP: Clicking the gate while the far side is still wet wastes turns; you must first raise the water enough to dry the window.

GOAL: Guide the 2x2 token to destroy the beam emitter. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token; clicks submit patterns to fire lasers. RULE: Lasers fire along the path the token just traveled in its final move. TRAP: Thinking order matters for clicks; it does not, only the final shape matters.

ESTABLISHED: The patrol follows your exact path, lagging exactly two moves behind; it safely enters your previous cell without colliding. FAILED: Assuming a head-on collision risk if it occupies a vacated cell; this fear is unfounded and caused unnecessary stalling. GOAL IS NOT: Avoiding the patrol or staying ahead of it indefinitely; the goal is simply reaching the exit while maintaining the two-step gap. CONTROLS: Moving updates the chase vector immediately; the patrol calculates its next position based on your current location, ensuring a consistent, safe distance.

GOAL: Guide two tokens to specific target dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active token; clicking a token switches which one you control. RULE: The token in the left half moves normally; the token in the right half moves inverted. TRAP: Assuming controls follow screen position rather than token identity causes constant confusion.

GOAL: Equalize liquid levels in two specific compartments to open a gate and route plugs. CONTROLS: Bottom buttons transfer liquid between adjacent compartments; top switches toggle gates. RULE: Gates open only when connected compartment levels match exactly, allowing plugs to pass through the band. TRAP: Ignoring button direction cost time; pressing the wrong side lowered the target compartment instead of raising it.

GOAL: Escape the maze by eating the item without being caught by the moving enemy. CONTROLS: Use directional arrows to move one square per step; enemies move automatically on their schedule. RULE: The enemy patrols a fixed loop; you must synchronize your position to enter the enemy's vacated square exactly when it leaves. TRAP: Assuming the enemy reacts to your position; it does not, so ignoring it entirely leads to collision, but over-reacting wastes moves.

GOAL: Guide two tokens to the same empty cell without hitting walls or hazards. CONTROLS: Arrows move both tokens simultaneously; clicks select the central dot for independent movement. RULE: The right token’s horizontal movement is inverted, while vertical movement remains normal for both. TRAP: Assuming both tokens move identically causes collisions and blocks progress, as the right token mirrors left and right commands.

GOAL: Place three beads to create a hub centered exactly on a ring. CONTROLS: Click a bead to move it to a target spot. RULE: The new hub position is the integer average of the three bead positions. TRAP: Assuming any bead placement works; you must calculate the average to land the hub inside the ring, not just near it.

GOAL: Fill the right tank to the top mark by moving a plug between tanks. CONTROLS: Click arrows to transfer liquid between tanks; click gates to move the plug. RULE: Gates open only when adjacent tank levels match exactly, allowing plug passage. TRAP: Believing tanks cannot empty; draining a tank to zero is valid and essential.

GOAL: Move the green arrow through the gate and align it with the target gap. CONTROLS: Clicking bars adjusts water levels; clicking the gate transfers the arrow. RULE: Water levels must match exactly to open the gate, and arrows land at the water's surface in the new band. TRAP: Raising water in the upper bands first blocks the lower gate, forcing a strict bottom-up sequence.

GOAL: Grow a token and teleport it to the upper frame. CONTROLS: Arrows move; clicking grows or teleports. RULE: Growth expands the grid while keeping it on gray squares. TRAP: Assuming growth anchors fixedly; it shifts unpredictably, risking invalid moves.

GOAL: Decode the hidden message by matching tile shapes to sky positions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys cycle the glyph patterns on each tile to find the correct visual match. RULE: The game matches tiles to sky slots using the longest possible string of identical shapes first. TRAP: Assuming all glyph classes are available in every tile’s cycle; some wide tiles lack specific shape pairs, forcing a different decoding path.

GOAL: Extend the orange bar down to touch the sparkle at the bottom. CONTROLS: Click to drop the cap, then click again to stretch the bar vertically. RULE: The bar can pass through panel lines but stops if it hits a solid box. TRAP: Thinking the panel area blocks movement; it only blocks horizontal extension, not vertical growth.

GOAL: Guide both agents to their targets to open the gates and finish the level. CONTROLS: Use arrow keys to move one agent at a time; pressing an arrow moves the selected character one step. RULE: Standing on a pressure plate keeps the corresponding gate open; remove weight and the gate closes. TRAP: Assuming the level ends immediately after moving; you must verify the completion status rather than relying on screen text alone.

GOAL: Move the arrow to the top of column B by raising the water level in container B to height 47. CONTROLS: Click arrows between containers to transfer three units of water from the source to the destination. RULE: The arrow moves into the container where the water level matches its current horizontal position. TRAP: Assuming water levels could not rise above the visible container walls prevented discovering that container B extends further right than it appears.

GOAL: Collect all colored dots using the correct shape at the right moment. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cursor; Space switches between the Plus and X shapes. RULE: The X collects dots only when its diagonal arms align with target positions. TRAP: Assuming the Plus shape can collect all dots; it misses diagonal targets, forcing unnecessary switching and wasted moves.

GOAL: Fit two T-shaped pieces into matching square outlines by maneuvering one piece to clear the path for the other. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the active piece in the chosen direction until it hits a wall or another piece. RULE: Pieces stop exactly where they first overlap a target outline, allowing them to snap into place even if they aren't fully inside yet. TRAP: Assuming a pushed piece stops just before contact; actually, it slides until it overlaps the obstacle, often overshooting the safe spot.

ESTABLISHED: The plug drops and is rejected by the ball when the notch faces North, even if key counts vary. FAILED: Rotating the notch to North with three or four keys active results in rejection. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the notch’s orientation to the plug’s shape. CONTROLS: Keys toggle the notch’s rotation; clicking the ball triggers the plug drop and absorption attempt.

GOAL: Move the diamond to the target zone while keeping the X in place. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space cycles selection between X, Diamond, and Plus. RULE: Shapes overlap at the start; Space changes selection without moving the shape. TRAP: Pressing Space when shapes share a center shows no visual change, causing uncertainty about which shape is active.

GOAL: Grow four colored bars to specific lengths by clicking their plus signs. CONTROLS: Click the plus icon on each color panel to extend that specific bar. RULE: Each click extends one bar by one unit, requiring precise counts for each color. TRAP: Assuming clicks affect multiple bars simultaneously wastes actions; only the targeted bar grows.

ESTABLISHED: Bars block liquid; touching a red bar swaps active colors. FAILED: Liquid pools below bars but does not swap unless fully overlapping or specific conditions met. GOAL IS NOT: Simply filling containers individually; simultaneous filling is required. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move selected bar; SPACE pours liquid from faucet.

GOAL: Align plugs to specific strips based on row coordinates. CONTROLS: Clicks moved plugs between strips or adjusted strip levels. RULE: Midpoint row values determined strip assignment via strict ranges. TRAP: Confusing notch markers with plugs due to similar clustering logic.

GOAL: Reach the exit while dodging patrolling guards and surviving strict collision rules. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step per press, consuming move budget. RULE: Never share a cell or swap places with a guard during movement. TRAP: Assuming a safe arrival time ignores the risk of mid-move intersection deaths.

GOAL: Rotate a block to fit its dock while moving it across the board. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block; Space rotates it. RULE: Only the active object responds to inputs; select it before acting. TRAP: Assuming movement works without clicking the block to activate it first.

GOAL: Guide the yellow T-piece north into the square hole. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your green block; clicking selects objects. RULE: Pushing a piece against an obstacle stops it exactly there, filling gaps perfectly. TRAP: Believing pieces slide indefinitely causes overshoot; precise positioning is required to hit the mark.

ESTABLISHED: The blue bar is a strict countdown that resets the level when empty. Ghosts replay fixed paths. FAILED: Attempting the full route without verifying if the first gate opens automatically from ghost presence. GOAL IS NOT: Located behind the first gate if that gate remains closed during your specific replay timing. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; spacebar records or plays back ghost loops; the bar decreases with every move.

GOAL: Route the plug to the notch by extending the upper channel while shrinking the lower one. CONTROLS: Clicking the upper channel expanded its range rightward and pulled the lower channel leftward. RULE: The plug always sits immediately after the upper channel's white end, so alignment required specific offset math. TRAP: Assuming both channels move independently; each expansion in the upper zone actively shrinks the lower zone.

GOAL: Connect the bar's left end to the green's bottom tip, then raise the spiral to link its top to the green and its bottom to the bar. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected piece; clicks selected the spiral to change its movement axis. RULE: Pieces only lock when their colored ends align perfectly with another piece's matching end. TRAP: Assuming the spiral would stay joined to the green while moving up; it detached, requiring re-alignment.

GOAL: Rotate and dock shape pieces by matching connector ports to build the target assembly. CONTROLS: Arrows move or rotate the active piece; Click selects a piece; Space confirms or locks a position. RULE: A connection forms automatically when connectors align, turning gray to lock the pieces together. TRAP: Clicking a new piece deselects the current one, forcing extra clicks if you fail to track which object is active before moving it.

GOAL: Slide the heavy block into the deep hole by approaching from above. CONTROLS: Arrows move your cursor; pushing a block shoves it one step further. RULE: Blocks slide until hitting a wall or another block, so aim for the gap. TRAP: Trying to push the block from the side leaves no room for it to land correctly.

GOAL: Move the dot from the purple box to the blue box using teleportation pads. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the dot; clicks activated the magenta teleporter. RULE: Teleporting swaps the dot’s position with the other pad only when standing on one. TRAP: Assuming pads vanish permanently; they respawn when the dot leaves, confusing position tracking.

GOAL: Guide the light dot to the glowing target square to complete the level. CONTROLS: Click to extend bars or rotate their direction toward the goal. RULE: Bars grow only in the direction they currently face, locking after extension. TRAP: Assuming the dot lands on the exact center of the target; it often triggers from an adjacent edge.

ESTABLISHED: Four blocks occupy separate rows. Releasing the beam fully un-grips them. Pushing a block against the right wall secures it. Gripping requires extending the beam until contact is blocked by a block. FAILED: Dragging multiple blocks simultaneously across rows without fully releasing them first causes jams and failed transport. GOAL IS NOT: Placing all blocks in a single row or keeping them gripped during initial positioning. CONTROLS: Left/Right retract/extend beam to push or grip. Up/Down shifts beam to target row.

GOAL: Fit four pieces into the frame to form a connected structure. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space rotates it; clicks select pieces. RULE: Pieces only snap into place when their colored ends align perfectly with matching sockets. TRAP: Assuming all pieces fit in their initial orientation; rotating the horizontal bar was essential to bridge the vertical gap.

GOAL: Place all four tokens into their matching rings. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move tokens or push neighbors; clicks select a token. RULE: A moving token pushes any adjacent token in its path, sliding it to a clear spot. TRAP: Believing the white highlight meant a token was locked; it only marked placement, still allowing pushes.

GOAL: Align top glyph pairs to match the bottom answer strip's grouped blocks. CONTROLS: Arrows rotated glyph cycles within each box until states matched targets. RULE: Bottom glyphs form paired blocks (1,1,2,1), requiring many-to-one or one-to-two mappings. TRAP: Reading bottom columns individually ignored the block grouping, causing false contradictions.

GOAL: Guide the player safely past the moving orange guard to the exit without being caught. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step; the orange guard moves simultaneously based on its path. RULE: The orange guard moves to a new cell every turn, so you must time your steps to avoid its current target. TRAP: Assuming the guard stays still; you must anticipate its next position, not just its current location.

GOAL: Light a specific panel square to close the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the box to position it. A click collapses lights. RULE: Clicking an end of a connected line of lights pushes them into the first empty space beyond the other end. TRAP: You might think clicking a light pushes it away. Actually, clicking the box pushes its internal light outward.

GOAL: Guide the runner through the maze to the exit while avoiding the patrolling guards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the runner one step up, down, left, or right between open floor tiles. RULE: Guards move automatically in straight lines, bouncing off walls; you must time your moves to cross their paths safely. TRAP: Assuming gray separator tiles are walls; they are actually open passages connecting the main floor cells.

GOAL: Navigate from the bottom to the yellow target at the top right. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token. Clicking bars toggles their orientation between horizontal and vertical. RULE: Toggling red to vertical creates a bridge across a gap; purple toggles solidify the path. TRAP: Forgetting to toggle the red bar leaves a gap in the path, making the route impossible.

ESTABLISHED: The left gap is blocked. The right gap requires the blue bar to rise at columns 30-32. Rotating the blue bar counter-clockwise is blocked by the bottom boundary if the green strip is too low. FAILED: Transit through the left gap. Rotating the blue bar when the green strip occupies rows 36-38. GOAL IS NOT: Reaching the sparkle from the left side. CONTROLS: Rotating the blue bar changes its direction relative to the joint, but its new position is constrained by the green strip's vertical placement and the bottom boundary.

GOAL: Route the plug through the wall’s hidden gap to reach the socket. CONTROLS: Click column segments to toggle pipe shapes; click the ball to launch it. RULE: A missing wall segment creates a clear path, letting you bypass blocked columns. TRAP: Assuming the wall is solid everywhere forces a long detour instead of the shortcut.

ESTFAILED: The liquid spreads across the central band and reaches the ceiling. Wetting these extra cells does not trigger a clear. The animation resets if the pour is messy. GOAL IS NOT: Simply filling all three notches while ignoring the spill. A wet cup is not enough. A clean pour that touches only the cups is not the only requirement. CONTROLS: Pouring liquid wets cells it touches. Wetting changes cell colors. The paddle deflects flow. Liquid settles into notches at the end of the pour.

ESTABLISHED: Moving green down, right, up, then left successfully pushed yellow1 into ring A, seating it and leaving green at (26,53). FAILED: Direct leftward path from (26,53) is blocked by walls at cols 23-25, preventing immediate progress toward the final ring. GOAL IS NOT: Simply seating yellow1; two other tokens must also be placed, and green must navigate around ring A. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move green; moving into a token pushes it if the space behind is open, seating it in a ring.

GOAL: Collect three hidden tokens to unlock the exit path. CONTROLS: Arrows move one step. Passing over a token refills your energy bar. RULE: Energy drains every move. You must route through tokens to survive the long walk to the box. TRAP: Thinking you could skip a token. Missing one refill guarantees you run out of energy before reaching the goal.

GOAL: Cover all red dots with the ring and all blue dots with the cross, avoiding mixed colors. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; Space cycles between the ring, plus, and cross shapes. RULE: Shapes must fully cover their target color dots without overlapping any dots of the opposite color. TRAP: Moving the cross first wastes time; start with the ring since it is the active shape by default.

ESTABLISHED: Destroying the block directly above causes the player to rise. A horizontal corridor exists above the starting position, blocked by a band of blocks. FAILED: Moving directly right or up without clearing overhead obstacles does nothing. GOAL IS NOT: The exit is not in the initial room or the first upper chamber. CONTROLS: Clicking a block destroys it. Arrow keys move the player. Destroying the block above forces an upward rise.

ESTABLISHED: A vertical corridor exists at column 42. Clicking a unit launches it away from the click point. Merging reduces the total count. The camera follows the active unit, limiting visibility to the immediate area. FAILED: Blindly merging units without mapping the full world risks stranding units in isolated spots, making the level unwinnable. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reducing the count to one. A single stranded unit cannot move, proving the goal requires both reduction and final positioning. CONTROLS: Click a unit to launch it. Merges occur on landing. The camera pans with movement. GOAL: Align two colored keys to specific panels by adjusting panel widths. CONTROLS: Click panels to widen or narrow them; click gates to swap keys. RULE: Gate clicks only work when adjacent panels match width, swapping all keys between them. TRAP: Assuming gates move single keys or ignoring that equal widths trigger simultaneous swaps for all present keys.

GOAL: guide a shrinking liquid tip through a narrow maze to reach the safe zone interior. CONTROLS: use arrow keys to move the liquid's edge in four directions. RULE: liquid expands only into empty space; solid walls block flow completely. TRAP: assuming liquid passes through thin walls causes wasted moves; verify open space before committing to long directional pushes.

GOAL: Shrink the central plug from two-by-two down to one-by-one. CONTROLS: Click horizontal bars and vertical stems to toggle their power states. RULE: Activating the top horizontal bar and the middle vertical stem simultaneously triggers the shrink effect. TRAP: Assuming the icon preview showed the final size of the plug rather than just its unit scale.

GOAL: Move the key through two gates by aligning water levels. CONTROLS: Buttons raised one pool while lowering another; clicking an open gate moved the key. RULE: A gate opened when the water’s right edge touched its left side. TRAP: Assuming any water level opened a gate, causing delays when the specific alignment wasn’t met.

GOAL: Match the legend color to the box glyph by cycling hues, then deliver the block to the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block; stepping on the pinwheel rotates the legend color through five stages. RULE: The box only accepts the block when its cap color exactly matches the current legend indicator. TRAP: Assuming the block's color changes automatically; only the pinwheel alters the legend, requiring precise pathing to sync colors before delivery.

ESTABLISHED: Merging is confirmed. The invader homes on the nearest piece, moving roughly four cells per axis per turn. Clicking near the invader is forbidden. FAILED: Placing pieces within twelve to thirteen cells of the invader. Using a simple four-cell step model for prediction. GOAL IS NOT: Simply maximizing distance. It is not a static defense, but a dynamic dance where pieces must actively avoid the homing enemy. CONTROLS: Click to place or merge pieces. The invader automatically moves toward the closest piece after every player action.

GOAL: Capture all red cells without dying. CONTROLS: Arrows move one step; guards stab adjacent facing cells. RULE: A guard is captured only when you enter its cell from a direction perpendicular to its gaze. TRAP: Assuming an orange on a red cell hides the threat; the red cell remains active, so entering it still kills you if the guard is not captured.

GOAL: Rotate the plug, color it purple, lower it through the wall, then grow it to fill the socket. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle bars and stems; use actions to rotate, color, move down, or grow the plug. RULE: Grow the plug only after it passes the wall, as the expanded size cannot fit through the gap. TRAP: Assuming the notch orientation matters during descent; it does not, so save rotations for the final alignment.

GOAL: Reach the top-right corner without getting caught by the guards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step in the chosen direction. RULE: Approach guards from the side or back to disable them safely. TRAP: Thinking guards stay still; moving into a facing guard captures you.

ESTABLISHED: Orange autonomously installs boxes; player movement does not directly install them. FAILED: Dragging boxes, standing on targets, and waiting for orange to finish all tasks. GOAL IS NOT: A standard Sokoban where you push boxes into slots yourself. CONTROLS: Arrows move; Space grabs/drops; Orange moves independently to nearest box.

GOAL: Ride the block with the peg to the exit and jump the final guard to clear the board. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a target cell to jump or move the block. RULE: A peg can land on a block, riding it to traverse the maze as a single unit. TRAP: Thinking a block is an obstacle rather than a vehicle that can carry the peg.

GOAL: Push all blocks onto the highlighted floor tiles to complete the shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move you; Space drops your held block; picking up blocks happens automatically by walking into them. RULE: The orange rival always moves opposite you, pushing blocks away rather than toward targets. TRAP: Trying to force the rival to place its block wastes turns; wait for it to clear space, then act.

GOAL: Reduce all scattered pegs to a single survivor by merging them. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a valid landing spot to jump and capture.
